name: comment-hygiene
description: Rewrites source comments to keep durable intent, invariants, and platform gotchas while stripping edit-history narration: ticket tokens, review provenance, sprint language, and stale archaeology.

interface.shortDescription: De-dust process narration out of code comments without losing invariants.
defaultPrompt: Use comment-hygiene to sweep this codebase's comments and apply the de-dusting pass.
